metadata.description: Prohibited and restricted items for import into UAE with documentation requirements
metadata.source: UAE Customs Law, Cabinet Decisions, and Ministry Regulations
metadata.important_note: This list is not exhaustive. Always verify current regulations with UAE Customs before import.

prohibited_items.description_en: All forms of illegal narcotics including heroin, cocaine, cannabis, synthetic drugs, and precursor chemicals
prohibited_items.description_ar: جميع أشكال المخدرات غير القانونية بما في ذلك الهيروين والكوكايين والحشيش والمخدرات الاصطناعية
prohibited_items.penalty: Severe criminal penalties including imprisonment and heavy fines under UAE anti-narcotics laws
prohibited_items.warning_message: 严禁 STRICTLY PROHIBITED - Import will result in immediate seizure, arrest, and prosecution. Life imprisonment or death penalty may apply.
prohibited_items.legal_reference: Federal Law No. 14 of 1995 on Countermeasures Against Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances
prohibited_items.exemptions: Licensed pharmaceutical manufacturers with Ministry of Health approval only

prohibited_items.description_en: Firearms, ammunition, explosives, military-grade equipment, and weapon parts without proper authorization
prohibited_items.description_ar: أسلحة نارية وذخائر ومتفجرات ومعدات عسكرية بدون ترخيص مناسب
prohibited_items.warning_message: PROHIBITED WITHOUT LICENSE - Requires special import permit from Ministry of Interior. Unauthorized import is a serious criminal offense.
prohibited_items.legal_reference: Federal Law No. 3 of 2009 on Arms, Ammunition, Explosives and Military Equipment
required_permits: Import License from Ministry of Interior
prohibited_items.exemptions: Government entities, military, licensed security companies only

prohibited_items.description_en: Fake branded products, pirated software, counterfeit currency, forged documents, trademark violations
prohibited_items.description_ar: منتجات مقلدة، برامج مقرصنة، عملات مزيفة
hs_codes_affected: ALL - Any HS code if counterfeit
prohibited_items.penalty: Confiscation, heavy fines (up to AED 1 million), imprisonment, deportation for non-citizens
prohibited_items.warning_message: 严禁 COUNTERFEIT GOODS PROHIBITED - UAE has strict intellectual property laws. All counterfeit items will be seized and destroyed.
prohibited_items.legal_reference: Federal Law No. 37 of 1992 on Trademarks (as amended)
prohibited_items.detection_methods: Brand authentication, certificate of authenticity verification

prohibited_items.description_en: Pornographic books, magazines, films, digital media, sex toys, and items contrary to Islamic values
prohibited_items.description_ar: مواد إباحية وكتب وأفلام مخالفة للقيم الإسلامية
prohibited_items.warning_message: PROHIBITED - Items contrary to UAE Islamic and moral values will be seized and destroyed.
prohibited_items.legal_reference: Federal Penal Code and UAE Cybercrime Law

prohibited_items.description_en: Ivory, rhino horn, tiger parts, rare animal skins, exotic birds, CITES-listed species without permits
prohibited_items.description_ar: عاج، قرن وحيد القرن، أجزاء النمور، جلود نادرة
prohibited_items.warning_message: PROTECTED SPECIES - Import prohibited under CITES Convention unless proper permits obtained from Ministry of Climate Change and Environment.
prohibited_items.legal_reference: CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species)
required_permits: CITES export permit from country of origin
CITES import permit from UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment
prohibited_items.exemptions: Licensed zoos, research institutions, registered dealers with full CITES documentation

prohibited_items.description_en: Slot machines, roulette wheels, poker machines, lottery tickets (except licensed entities)
prohibited_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Gambling is generally prohibited in UAE. Only licensed entities (casinos in designated zones) may import.
prohibited_items.exemptions: Licensed gaming establishments in authorized zones (Ras Al Khaimah designated areas)

prohibited_items.item_name: Goods of Israeli origin (outdated - post Abraham Accords)
prohibited_items.description_en: Historical boycott lifted in 2020 after Abraham Accords normalization
prohibited_items.description_ar: المقاطعة التاريخية تم رفعها في 2020 بعد اتفاقيات أبراهام
prohibited_items.warning_message: NOTICE: Post-2020, Israeli goods are permitted following UAE-Israel normalization (Abraham Accords)
prohibited_items.exemptions: All goods from Israel now permitted with normal customs procedures

prohibited_items.description_en: Radioactive isotopes, nuclear materials, radioactive waste without authorization
prohibited_items.description_ar: مواد مشعة ونفايات نووية بدون ترخيص
prohibited_items.warning_message: HIGHLY RESTRICTED - Requires Federal Authority for Nuclear Regulation (FANR) license. Unauthorized import is a serious crime.
prohibited_items.legal_reference: Federal Law No. 6 of 2009 on Peaceful Uses of Nuclear Energy
prohibited_items.exemptions: Licensed medical facilities, research institutions, ENEC (Emirates Nuclear Energy Corporation)

prohibited_items.item_name: Religious materials for proselytizing or offensive to Islam
prohibited_items.description_en: Materials deemed offensive to Islam or intended for unauthorized religious proselytizing
prohibited_items.description_ar: مواد دينية مسيئة للإسلام أو للتبشير غير المصرح به
prohibited_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Religious materials must respect UAE values. Items for personal use (reasonable quantities) generally permitted.
prohibited_items.legal_reference: UAE Penal Code and Religious Affairs regulations
prohibited_items.exemptions: Personal religious items in reasonable quantities for own use

prohibited_items.description_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles, drones, and related equipment without proper authorization
prohibited_items.description_ar: طائرات بدون طيار بدون ترخيص مناسب
prohibited_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - All drones must be registered with GCAA (General Civil Aviation Authority). Unauthorized import is prohibited.
prohibited_items.exemptions: Registered recreational drones under 250g may have simplified procedures

restricted_items.description_en: Beer, wine, spirits, and all alcoholic drinks
restricted_items.description_ar: مشروبات كحولية - بيرة، نبيذ، مشروبات روحية
restricted_items.penalty: Confiscation, fines, imprisonment for unauthorized import
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Alcohol import requires license. Non-Muslim residents can obtain personal import permit. Commercial import requires liquor license.
required_permits: Liquor license (for commercial import - hotels, restaurants, specialized retailers)
restricted_items.issuing_authority: Respective Emirate's Alcohol Control Department (Dubai Police, Abu Dhabi Police, etc.)
restricted_items.personal_allowance: 4 liters of alcohol OR 24 cans of beer for personal use per month (non-Muslims only)
restricted_items.prohibited_locations: Emirate of Sharjah (completely dry - no alcohol permitted)
restricted_items.notes: Each Emirate has its own alcohol regulations. Sharjah prohibits all alcohol. Dubai and Abu Dhabi allow licensed import.

restricted_items.description_en: Cigarettes, cigars, tobacco, e-cigarettes, vaping devices, shisha tobacco
restricted_items.penalty: Heavy excise tax applies, confiscation if limits exceeded
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Subject to 100% excise tax. Import limits apply.
required_permits: No special permit for personal quantities
restricted_items.personal_allowance: 400 cigarettes or 2kg of tobacco products for personal use
restricted_items.excise_tax: 100% on tobacco products, 100% on e-cigarettes and liquids
additional_requirements: Excise tax payment before customs clearance
restricted_items.notes: E-cigarettes and vaping products recently legalized but heavily taxed. Shisha tobacco popular but taxed.

restricted_items.description_en: Prescription drugs, psychotropic medications, controlled medical substances
restricted_items.description_ar: أدوية بوصفة طبية، مواد خاضعة للرقابة
restricted_items.penalty: Confiscation, fines, possible criminal charges for controlled substances
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Prescription required for personal import. Controlled substances require Ministry of Health approval.
required_permits: Ministry of Health approval for controlled/psychotropic medications
Medication must be in original packaging with pharmacy label
restricted_items.personal_allowance: Up to 3 months supply for personal use with valid prescription
prohibited_medications: Psychotropic substances (sleeping pills, anxiety medications) without special approval
Certain pain medications (Tramadol, Codeine) - require advance approval
additional_requirements: Advance approval for controlled medications (apply 2-4 weeks before travel)
restricted_items.notes: Common pain relievers like Tramadol are controlled. Check MOHAP website for full list of controlled medications.

restricted_items.description_en: Pets, livestock, birds, plants, seeds, agricultural products
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Requires import permit, health certificate, and quarantine procedures.
required_permits: Import permit from Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)
Veterinary health certificate from country of origin
Rabies vaccination certificate (min 30 days old, max 1 year)
restricted_items.issuing_authority: Ministry of Climate Change and Environment
restricted_items.quarantine_requirements: Quarantine period may apply (varies by species and origin)
prohibited_breeds: Dangerous dog breeds (Pit Bull, American Staffordshire Terrier, etc.)
additional_requirements: Import must be through designated ports with quarantine facilities
restricted_items.notes: Dubai has specific regulations for pet import. Some dog breeds are banned.

restricted_items.item_name: Gold, silver, and precious metals (large quantities)
restricted_items.description_en: Bullion, gold bars, large quantities of precious metals for commercial purposes
restricted_items.description_ar: سبائك ذهب، معادن ثمينة بكميات كبيرة
restricted_items.penalty: Confiscation, money laundering investigation if not declared
restricted_items.warning_message: MUST DECLARE - All precious metals must be declared. Commercial import requires special registration.
required_permits: Registration with DMCC (Dubai Multi Commodities Centre) for gold trade
restricted_items.issuing_authority: Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC), Ministry of Economy
restricted_items.declaration_threshold: All quantities must be declared, especially over AED 60,000 (USD 16,000)
additional_requirements: Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation for large amounts
restricted_items.notes: UAE is major gold trading hub. Legitimate trade welcomed but must follow AML/KYC procedures.

restricted_items.description_en: Radio transmitters, satellite equipment, encryption devices, wireless communication devices
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Requires TDRA (Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority) approval for certain equipment.
required_permits: TDRA type approval for wireless devices
restricted_items.issuing_authority: Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA)
restricted_items.exemptions: Consumer devices (smartphones, WiFi routers) generally exempt if type-approved
restricted_items.notes: Professional radio equipment, satellite phones, high-power transmitters require permits

restricted_items.description_en: Toxic chemicals, corrosive substances, flammable materials, industrial chemicals
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Requires permits, MSDS, and compliance with UAE hazmat regulations.
required_permits: Import permit from relevant authorities (varies by chemical)
Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) in English and Arabic
restricted_items.issuing_authority: Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, Local Environmental Authorities
prohibited_chemicals: Certain pesticides and toxic chemicals - check Stockholm Convention list
restricted_items.notes: UAE strictly regulates hazmat. Full compliance with GHS and local environmental laws required.

restricted_items.description_en: Food supplements, vitamins, protein powders, herbal supplements
restricted_items.penalty: Confiscation if not registered or banned ingredients found
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Must be registered with ESMA. Check for prohibited ingredients (ephedra, DMAA, etc.).
required_permits: Product registration with Emirates Authority for Standardization and Metrology (ESMA)
restricted_items.issuing_authority: Emirates Authority for Standardization and Metrology (ESMA)
restricted_items.personal_allowance: Up to 3 months supply for personal use (no registration needed)
restricted_items.notes: Bodybuilding supplements popular but heavily scrutinized. Check ESMA banned list before import.

restricted_items.description_en: Botox, dermal fillers, cosmetic injectables, laser devices
restricted_items.penalty: Confiscation, heavy fines, clinic closure if used without license
restricted_items.warning_message: HIGHLY RESTRICTED - Only licensed medical facilities can import. Requires Ministry of Health approval.
restricted_items.issuing_authority: Ministry of Health and Prevention, Dubai Health Authority (DHA), Abu Dhabi DOH
additional_requirements: End-user must be licensed medical facility
restricted_items.notes: Cosmetic procedures highly regulated. Only licensed clinics with qualified doctors can import and administer.

restricted_items.description_en: Professional drones, commercial UAVs, drone cameras for surveying/filming
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Must register with GCAA. Flying without registration/license is illegal and heavily fined.
restricted_items.exemptions: Recreational drones under 250g have simplified registration
additional_requirements: Flight plan approval for each flight
No-fly zone compliance (airports, government buildings, etc.)
restricted_items.no_fly_zones: 15km around airports, government facilities, royal palaces, military areas
restricted_items.notes: Dubai and Abu Dhabi have drone detection systems. Unauthorized flights detected and penalized quickly.

restricted_items.description_en: Cash, bearer bonds, travelers cheques exceeding declaration threshold
restricted_items.penalty: Confiscation, money laundering investigation, heavy fines
restricted_items.warning_message: MUST DECLARE - Amounts over AED 60,000 (or equivalent ~USD 16,000) must be declared to customs.
additional_requirements: Source of funds documentation may be requested
restricted_items.notes: Failure to declare can result in full confiscation. UAE takes AML very seriously.

restricted_items.description_en: Pork meat, bacon, ham, lard, pork-containing food products
restricted_items.penalty: Confiscation if imported for unauthorized use
restricted_items.warning_message: RESTRICTED - Pork import permitted only for licensed non-Muslim outlets and hotels.
required_permits: Special pork import license (for designated retailers)
License to sell pork (hotels, specialized shops)
restricted_items.personal_allowance: Small quantities for personal consumption by non-Muslims generally allowed (check with customs)
additional_requirements: Must be sold in designated sections separated from halal products
restricted_items.designated_outlets: Specific licensed stores (e.g., Spinney's pork section, certain hotel restaurants)
restricted_items.notes: Available in Dubai and Abu Dhabi in designated sections. Completely prohibited in Sharjah.

general_compliance_notes.declaration_principle: When in doubt, declare. Non-declaration is worse than declaring and being rejected.
general_compliance_notes.documentation: Always carry proper documentation (invoices, certificates, permits) with shipments.
general_compliance_notes.advance_approval: For restricted items, apply for permits BEFORE shipping to avoid delays and costs.
general_compliance_notes.customs_inspection: UAE Customs uses advanced scanning and inspection. Concealment attempts are detected and penalized.
general_compliance_notes.penalties: Penalties range from fines to confiscation to criminal prosecution depending on violation severity.
general_compliance_notes.legal_advice: For commercial imports of sensitive items, consult with customs broker or legal advisor.

red_flag_keywords.description: Keywords that trigger additional scrutiny during AI classification
red_flag_keywords.action_on_detection: Flag for immediate human review, provide prohibition warning
